title: Puig charts path to EUR 8 billion through core brands and selective deals
summary: Following the failure of merger discussions with The Estée Lauder Companies in May, Puig is setting out an independent growth strategy, aiming to become a company generating more than EUR 8 billion (approx. USD 8,97 billion) in annual revenues by 2032. Under its new Vision 2032 roadmap, the Spanish beauty group plans to accelerate international expansion, strengthen its core brands and integrate its global operations while preserving their creative autonomy.
